Theme

Latin word

Ecce!

with the nominative or a clause (in comedy also the accusative)

look! see! behold!

In this lexicon

  • look!

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Most. 382: Ecce autem iterum hīc dēposīvit caput et dormit.; Cic. Att. 2.8.1: ecce tibi nūntius puerōs vēnisse Rōmā!

Examples

  • Ecce autem iterum hīc dēposīvit caput et dormit. suscitā.

    Look, he’s put his head down again and is asleep. Wake him.Plaut. Most. 382
